title: Kafka Online Training
description:
ABOUT KAFKA ONLINE TRAINING:

Apache Kafka Online Training  is an open source data streaming system. it’s designed to efficiently manage and process messaging system. The messages are produced and checked at the speed of milliseconds. Kafka is employed to putting together a real-time data pipelines. it’s a distributed streaming platform. The distributed meaning it exactly publishes and subscribes to stream of records. Kafka is typically good for building real-time streaming. Also, it helps to create a real-time streaming application. It are often run on one or more server.

WHAT ARE THE PREREQUISITES FOR THE APACHE KAFKA COURSE?

  • Anybody can take this training course.
  • Having a background in Java is beneficial.
  • Database  concept
  • Unix/Linux
